title: Two encounters in entirely different regions (a bear/lynx den on the Saltkerns coast, and a hidden cell under Marrowgate) presented word-for-word identical room and NPC templates ('Doesn't look up first. Looks up eventually, and takes your measure quick.') down to the same dialogue options and resolution checks — reads as a reused encounter stamped into two locations rather than two distinct scenes.
